title: Viva! Django
description: A cowboy runs into arms dealers while searching for the men who raped and killed his wife.

title: And God Said to Cain
description: President Grant's amnesty frees a gold-mine owner to hunt the bandits who framed him.

title: Gentleman Killer
description: A dapper stranger shoots schemers in a border town about to be declared U.S. or Mexican.

title: Black Tigress
description: Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in the town of Sant'Anna with some other dancers. The town is terrorized by El Diablo, an outlaw who wants to sell the surrounding land to the railroad company. Lola helps the colonists rebel.

title: Return of Shanghai Joe
description: Shanghai Joe (Cheen Lie) and a friendly snake-oil salesman take on a sinister town boss (Klaus Kinski) who uses violence on those who oppose his demands.

title: Requiescant
description: The son of a Mexican bandit finds a village that is controlled by a former Confederate officer who steals from the locals.

title: Professionals For A Massacre
description: Three imprisoned soldiers agree to recover a cache of stolen Army gold in exchange for their freedom.

title: His Name Was King
description: A Westerner (Klaus Kinski) hunts the outlaws who have killed his brother and attacked his wife.

title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
description: Seven masked bandits kidnap young Susy, who is the cousin of the mayor of Clayton City, and hold her for a $15,000 ransom.

title: Run Man Run
description: An unlucky thief makes a friend in prison and from there goes hunting for buried gold.

title: My Name Is Pecos
description: Bandits search for a barrel of loot hidden by a witness to a stagecoach robbery.

title: Bad Man's River
description: An outlaw and two con men attempt to relieve the Mexican government of $1 million. Once the scam is completed, they have to avoid the attentions of, amongst others, the Mexican army and Billy the Kid - all of whom are eager to claim the cash for themselves.

title: The White, the Yellow, and the Black
description: In the 19th century, the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President, but it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians. Sheriff Gideon, assisted by a clumsy Japanese servant, steps up to deliver the ransom.

title: My Gun is the Law
description: In San Felipe, bandits target gold meant for the railroad, until a decoy chest thwarts them. When newcomers arrive, a masked gunman begins sabotaging the outlaws. But the real mastermind may be the town's respected leader, hiding treachery behind wealth and charm.

title: Day After Tomorrow
description: A man comes to Canyon City and becomes involved with two feuding factions after a bank clerk gets killed during a botched holdup.

title: May God Forgive You... But I Won't
description: While Cjamango is away from his farm, six bandits murder his family. Coming to terms with this tragedy, he sets out to avenge his loved ones.

title: Seven Alone
description: In the 1840s, the Sager family decides to brave the journey to Oregon in hopes of a better life. While traveling along the trail, their wagon train is attacked by natives, which results in the father's death. Shortly after, the family experiences another tragedy when the mother dies of pneumonia. When the wagon train leaders dismiss the seven orphans from the group, the oldest child, John (Stewart Petersen), decides to lead his brothers and sisters to the new life his parents wanted.

title: Against a Crooked Sky
description: When the eldest daughter of a family of settlers is captured by an American Indian warrior, her brother, Sam Sutter (Stewart Petersen), sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he encounters a wise, but alcoholic trapper named Russian (Richard Boone) who agrees to help him. The pair's journey into the remote Red Rock region of Utah is a perilous one, which ultimately brings them face to face with Chief Cut Tongue (Henry Wilcoxon), whose solution to the situation is a treacherous one.

title: Last of the Renegades
description: Old Shatterhand, Winnetou and Castlepool battle a ruthless oil baron trying to create a war between Native Americans and white settlers.

title: Texas, Adiós
description: A sheriff (Franco Nero) ventures into Mexico to find the crime boss who murdered his father.

title: White Apache
description: An Apache chief raises a white child as his own son.

title: If You Meet Sartana Pray for Your Death
description: Nobody knows a mysterious gunfighter who has joined a scramble for stagecoach gold.

title: The Shooting
description: In the American West, Willet Gashade (Warren Oates), a former bounty hunter, and Coley Boyard (Will Hutchins), his dimwitted partner, are approached by a secretive young woman (Millie Perkins) who offers them money to guide her through the desert but refuses to discuss why she is traveling. The group embarks on the journey and is eventually joined by Billy Spear (Jack Nicholson), a volatile gunslinger the woman has also hired. The only question is why.

title: Sabata the Killer
description: Bank robbers go on the run after a heist when the bank's manager hires a posse to track them down.

title: Days Of Violence
description: A man's brother is killed by an army man during the last months of the Civil War. To avenge his brother's death, he decides to join a group of Southerners determined to resist the army till the very end.
